public_rationale: The verified record does not establish that Perplexity had never recorded a profitable period. Reporting on gross margins and cost classification cannot substitute for historical net income. A competing AI-search offering was available before the post, but competition alone does not establish heavy commoditization. Neither component is sufficiently settled to support the combined claim.
limitations: The underlying financial articles could not be read, so their search excerpts were excluded.
The accessible financial article is secondary reporting.
Product availability provides no direct measure of substitutability or pricing power.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Perplexity only ever loses money and its AI search product is heavily commoditized.

statement.excerpt: Perplexity, like every generative AI company, only ever loses money, and its product — generative AI-powered search — is so commoditized that it's actually remarkable the company still exists.

our_interpretation: Only ever loses money ordinarily means no profitable reporting period in the company's history through publication.

The context identifies 2024 as the latest annual financial period. The financial scope therefore covers historical realized results through that year; intervening results would also matter if publicly reportable.
Commoditized means close substitutes leave little differentiation or pricing power. Merely having competitors is insufficient.
The remark that continued existence is remarkable is evaluative and is not separately scored.
The central target is Perplexity. The universal comparison with every generative AI company is broader and is not silently treated as established.
The accounting basis is estimate because the surrounding financial discussion relies on press reporting.
criteria.support_condition: A reliable historical record shows no profitable reporting period, and comparative evidence establishes close substitution with little differentiation or pricing power.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A reliable comparable profitable period contradicts only ever loses money. Evidence of durable differentiation and protected pricing power could separately contradict the commoditization assertion.

evidence.explanation: The article describes classification of costs associated with non-paying users. This shows why a gross-margin figure cannot settle the claim about total company profitability.
A broadly available competing AI-search product existed before publication. Its availability does not establish equivalent quality, customer substitutability, or Perplexity's pricing power.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A consistent historical financial record through the post, plus contemporaneous comparative search evaluations and customer or pricing evidence establishing the extent of substitution.
